newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tenders for 200,000 tonnes of wheat.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tenders for 200,000 tonnes of wheat.

text.p: Bangladesh has tendered for 200,000 tonnes of U.S. grade-2 wheat for shipment in January and February, food ministry officials said on Tuesday.
They said the ministry would receive offers until 0600 GMT on November 30. The shipment for the first 100,000 tonnes should be completed by January 10 and the rest by February 10.
The results of the bids will not be known until December 3 when a cabinet meeting decides on the offers, the officials said.
